article_content: Glendale resident Ashley King claims an eyebrow wax at Annie's Fashion Nails caused severe injury, resulting in torn eyelid skin and burns. After paying $10 for the service, King described experiencing intense pain during the waxing process, with the technician continuing despite her protests. Post-treatment, her boyfriend observed visible skin loss on her eyelids, prompting immediate medical evaluation. A doctor confirmed second-degree burns and partial skin removal. Despite photographic evidence presented to authorities, salon owner Annie denied liability, attributing the incident to 'sensitive skin.' While the $10 fee was eventually refunded, the business maintains no culpability. King has filed formal complaints with Arizona's cosmetology regulators and the Better Business Bureau, which now lists the salon with a D- rating. Historical records reveal a 2010 Yelp review describing similar toe-waxing injuries, hinting at potential systemic issues within the establishment. Among its four Yelp listings, three praise affordability and staff friendliness, though one corroborates injury concerns.

article_content: In 2015, NASA's New Horizons spacecraft will reach Pluto—carrying a symbolic payload: the ashes of Clyde Tombaugh, the astronomer who discovered the icy world in 1930. Born in Missouri, Tombaugh identified Pluto as a faint speck in photographic plates at Lowell Observatory. Upon his death in 1997, he requested his remains be sent into space—a wish fulfilled by this mission. After nearly a decade traveling through the solar system, the spacecraft now nears its target. A small container bearing Tombaugh's ashes, inscribed with his name and title as 'discoverer of Pluto,' rests aboard. Pluto, named by an 11-year-old girl after the Roman underworld deity, remains poorly understood. Its vast distance from Earth (3.67 billion miles) makes direct observation challenging, appearing only as a pinpoint even through the Hubble telescope. Recent Hubble images reveal a mottled, reddish surface possibly influenced by seasonal thawing of frozen gases. Scientists speculate that methane and nitrogen ices form Pluto's crust, while its weak gravity allows a thin atmosphere to escape during closer solar approaches. The New Horizons mission, costing $720 million, aims to transform Pluto from a blurry enigma into a well-mapped world. Equipped with cameras and spectrometers, it will study surface composition, atmospheric dynamics, and interactions with solar winds. The probe's July 2015 flyby will mark humanity's first close encounter with this distant dwarf planet. Despite its demotion from full planetary status in 2006, Pluto retains immense scientific value as a relic of the solar system's formation. Mission leader Alan Stern anticipates groundbreaking insights, comparing potential discoveries to past revelations about Io's volcanoes or Titan's lakes. Tombaugh's ashes thus symbolize both personal legacy and humanity's enduring curiosity about cosmic frontiers.

Роден во Мисури, Томбау ја идентификуваше Плутон како мртво тачко во фотографски таблови во Лоув Оберваториум. На неговата смрт во 1997 година, тој сакал да му се овозможат останките да бидат сложени во космос—желбата што е исполнета со овој мисија. Следење девет години патување низ сончарот, апаратот сега се приближува кон целта. Мањкаш контејнер со неговите останки, наречен со името и титлата „откривач на Плутон“, се наоѓа на бордов. Именот Плутон му даде 11годишна момчиња по римского бог на подземното царство, но ќе остане малку разбран. Степенот на неговата оддалеченост од Земјата (3,67 милијарди мили) прави директното набљудување можно само како точка преку Хаблова телескоп. Новите слики од Хабл предизвикуваат мотливи, црвено-црниот површински облик можеби влијание од сезонски промени. Учените ги предвидуваат дека метан и азот се формираат како кора, додека слабата гравитација позволява на тонки атмосфера да се избегнуваат во моментите кога се приближува до Сунцето. Мисијата Нови Хоризонси, со бюджет од 720 милиони долари, се насочува да промени Плутон од нејзината неразбраност во детално картографиран свет. Екипиран со камери и спектрометри, ќе истражува композиција на површината, динамика на атмосферата и интеракции со соларни ветрови. Флај-биј-процесот во јули 2015 ќе биде првиот приближен контакт на човечеството со овој далечен квазипланет. Сѐ додека го изгубило планетарниот статус во 2006, Плутон го задржува научната важност како реликв на формирањето на сончарот. Лидерот на мисијата Алън Стърн предвидува променливи откриви, споредувајќи ги со предходни откривања за вулканите на Йо или луките на Титан. Останките на Томбау ги означуваат и неговата персонална наследница и човечката трагодија за космички фронтира.

article_content: The lawsuit filed by Michael Jackson’s family against concert promoter AEG could resolve years of speculation about the biological father of the late singer’s three children. The case, which includes Jackson’s children Paris, Prince, and Blanket, along with his mother Katherine, accuses AEG of contributing to Jackson’s 2009 death by overworking him during preparations for the 'This Is It' tour and employing Dr. Conrad Murray, whose propofol administration caused his fatal overdose. During the trial’s upcoming award phase, AEG plans to submit evidence challenging Jackson’s claims, asserting only the youngest child, Blanket, is biologically his. Despite this, Jackson’s family has urged the court to exclude paternity evidence, deeming it irrelevant and harmful to the family’s reputation. AEG counters that Jackson’s alleged secrecy about his children’s parentage reflects broader concealments, including drug use, alcohol consumption, and strained familial relationships. While Paris (15) and Prince (16) share their mother Debbie Rowe, Blanket’s mother remains unnamed but reportedly a San Diego-area Hispanic woman. Several individuals—including dermatologist Arnold Klein, bodyguard Matt Fiddes, and actor Mark Lester—have publicly claimed paternity of Paris and Prince, though none dispute AEG’s assertion regarding Blanket’s lineage. A family insider stated, 'Blanket looks just like him; there’s no doubt he’s Michael’s.'

article_content: The Paralympics closing ceremony began with a post-apocalyptic Mad Max-style invasion of the Olympic Stadium. Performers arrived in welded British-made vehicles, burning bicycles, and unconventional machinery reminiscent of Mel Gibson's 1979 film 'Mad Max.' The Festival of the Flame event featured Prince Edward entering in a carriage constructed from repurposed cars. War hero Captain Luke Sinnott, who lost limbs in a 2010 Afghanistan explosion while safeguarding comrades, ascended a flagpole to hoist the Union Flag. Stephen Daldry, executive producer, called the flag reveal 'devastatingly emotional.' Sinnott, aiming to compete in Rio 2016 via a Help for Heroes-funded boat, was supported by charity members. The ceremony also showcased a custom car driven by Captain Tony Harris (who lost a leg in Afghanistan), 54 drummers, and singer Lissa Hermans performing the National Anthem. Coldplay's Chris Martin praised the honor of performing, while Rihanna highlighted Paralympians as 'gladiators of inspiration.' Athletes celebrated under fireworks as the flame was extinguished and transferred to Rio.

article_content: In 2008, Brazilian defender Breno joined Bayern Munich as a promising 17-year-old. By 2012, his career collapsed when he was sentenced to 3 years and 9 months for arson at his Munich residence during severe depression. After completing 13 months of his sentence, Breno now participates in daytime rehabilitation through Bayern's youth academy. Club president Uli Hoeness highlighted his exemplary behavior in prison, stating Bayern would assist his recovery. Sao Paulo FC has also shown interest in reintegrating the former star, though deportation concerns limit his options. Despite not playing professionally since April 2011, Breno maintains hope: 'Rejoining training brings me closer to my dream of returning to the field.'
